responsibility: Implements GCC’s ThreadSanitizer instrumentation pass, scanning GIMPLE memory operations and synchronization-relevant constructs to insert calls to the TSan runtime for reads, writes, ranges, atomics-related entry points, and optional function entry/exit tracking. The file contains the logic that classifies memory accesses by size, volatility, addressability, alignment, and special cases such as bit-fields or virtual-pointer stores, rewrites TSAN_FUNC_EXIT internal calls, emits __tsan_init in a TU constructor, and provides both optimized and -O0 pass instances for SANITIZE_THREAD.
same_name_distinction: Implementation companion to gcc/tsan.h: this source file defines the ThreadSanitizer GIMPLE passes and the logic that classifies and instruments memory accesses, function entry/exit, and module initialization. Unlike the header, it is not just the tiny interface declaration layer exposing tsan_finish_file.
